episodes.title: Good Golly Miss Dolly, We're Trying
episodes.description: Hi friends! This week looks a little different, because the day that Dolly left this world, so did our video-to-audio compatibility… 😭 We’ve spent ALL WEEK trying to fix this snaky little thing called audio drift , but unfortunately, we had to call it and upload this one audio-only. We deeply apologize that you don’t get to see our ridiculous facial expressions throughout the episode-but don’t worry! If we get it fixed, we’ll just re-upload with video! 😂 Thank you guys for always being so loving, patient, and understanding as these two girls navigate the craziness that comes with doing this podcast. We appreciate you more than you know. 🥹💕 ANYWAY… our Sips of the Week are Bananas Foster Black Tea , which was a birthday gift to M from one of our listeners!! 🥹🍌☕ And speaking of birthdays… M turns 30 THE DAY THIS EPISODE IS RELEASED!!! 🎂✨ So naturally, in between fighting technology and mourning our video, we’ve also been preparing for M to officially enter her 30s. And, of course, we couldn’t let this week pass without talking about the absolute amazingness that is Dolly Parton and all the joy she brought into this world. 💕🌸 So thank you for your patience, your love, and for sticking with us through the technical difficulties. Grab your favorite drink, get cozy, and let’s jump into another week of Chittin’ and Chattin’! 🫶

episodes.title: If You Give a Neuro-Spicy Brain a Cookie
episodes.description: This week’s Sips of the Week went HARD with a homemade salted caramel mocha freeze-complete with M’s frozen coffee ice cubes because apparently regular ice just wasn’t enough. We paired our frozen coffee creations with gluten-free Oreos and cookies, which naturally led to the VERY important question: how do you eat your Oreo? And from there… somehow we ended up discussing favorite colors, Steven Universe , and whether M knows who Amethyst is (spoiler: she does not ). One childhood rabbit hole leads to another as we reminisce about Kipper the Dog , SpongeBob quotes, and Syd’s questionable childhood decision to have a Megan Fox poster in her room. We also talk about the untimely passing of Hayden Panettiere and spiral into some fun facts about our neuro-spicy brains . And listen… if you had a strong emotional connection to If You Give a Mouse a Cookie , you might need to hear this one. 👀 Syd also shares a story about accidentally blurting out her INTERNAL THOUGHTS to a police officer… thoughts that probably should have remained safely inside her brain. 🫠 We have another update in the ongoing saga of Syd’s ever-changing taste buds (raw tomatoes AND crab legs?! Who is she?!), and we’re officially going FBI detective mode to track down a mysterious buffet M remembers from her childhood in Colorado. Of course, we’ve got an AITA-style Spill It, Bestie , and we have some VERY strong feelings about who was the a-hole. Plus, we have a brand-new puzzle on the website that neither of us has managed to beat yet. In our defense, we were both half asleep when we tried it… so technically, the puzzle hasn’t won. 😌 Come hang out, get cozy, sip along, and prepare for approximately 47 completely unrelated rabbit holes. 🐇☕️

episodes.title: Buckle Up Buttercup... The Moon Knows
episodes.description: Sips of the Week are farmers market vibes with blueberry iced tea and lemonade for a little homemade Arnold Palmer! 🫐🍋 And in a shocking confession, Sydney reveals she HATED tea her entire childhood… despite being raised a southern bumpkin. Naturally, one conversation spirals into another, and suddenly we’re hearing the absolutely hilarious story of how basic training somehow changed Sydney’s opinion on mustard. We talk about working our booties off, Sydney’s growing excitement for Louder Than Life, and-because apparently our brains refuse to stay on one topic-her STRANGE dreams. Those dreams lead us straight into our true crime detective era, complete with random license plates being saved in our Notes app like we’re solving a case. 🕵️‍♀️ Then M takes us on a little moon fact journey because we’re entering a new moon , and apparently the moon has been keeping tabs on us this whole time. 🌙 We dive into what it means that Sydney was born under a waning crescent moon while M was born under a waning gibbous , and let’s just say… some things hit a little too close to home. We also celebrate our website and how cool it’s been watching this little podcast grow. AND we got our first submission through the website!! 🥹💌 We love seeing you guys become part of this crazy little corner of the internet with us. With M’s birthday VERY VERY soon, we get a little deeper and talk about healing, learning to love every part of yourself, and realizing that YES, you are absolutely allowed to celebrate yourself. 🎂✨ Sydney also shares a few relationship tid-bits that she doesn’t hear talked about nearly enough-but are things she wholeheartedly lives by. Basically… blueberry tea, mustard, dreams, crime-solving, moon magic, self-love, birthdays, and a whole lot of spiraling. Just another episode of Chittin’ and Chattin’ . ☕️🌙💗

episodes.title: We're Connecting Dots Again...
episodes.description: This week’s Sips of the Week is a cozy lemon ginger tea with brown sugar cinnamon syrup - delicious and a little spiritually charged, apparently. From there, we spiral (in the best way) into the idea that nothing in the universe is random. We talk numerology, Pythagoras, and how different cultures assign meaning to numbers - including Syd’s 33 (the Master Teacher) and M’s 8 (the powerhouse). Of course, we fully accept these identities. 😂 Find your "Life Path" number at: https://www.tokenrock.com/numerology/life-path-number-calculator/ or just search, Token Rock Life Path Number We also get into career shifts, LinkedIn glow-ups, and the reminder that we’re not starting over - we’re building on everything we’ve already done. Then it’s all about signs from the universe: butterflies, dragonflies, praying mantises, and those little moments that make you go… “wait, is this something?” Somehow we also end up questioning history timelines, debating music volume rules, and confirming that Syd would absolutely adopt every child if she became a teacher. And in true Spill It, Bestie fashion, we’ve got chaos: foster kids, family life, a suspicious water bottle, and a note that sends an ex into a spiral. Oh - and BIG NEWS… we have a website!!! 🎉💻 Check us out, scroll the archives of all our previous Sips of the Week, and send any submissions for any of our segments on: https://chittinandchattin.com Come hang with us for another episode of rabbit holes, realizations, and the gentle reminder that maybe… nothing is random.

episodes.title: Paganism, Plot Twists & Frozen Margaritas
episodes.description: Sips of the Week are STRAWBERRY WATERMELON MINT FROZEN MARGARITAS , because honestly… we deserved this one. And spoiler alert: we DID go see Hilary Duff after we filmed. 💅🏼 Syd is soaking up her last few days of “freedom” before starting a new job that is basically going to have her working nonstop until the season ends in November. RIP to her days off. 😂 We dive right in with M teaching us all about paganism, and naturally, one topic turns into about five rabbit holes. We also take a little trip down memory lane as we reminisce about M deciding to leave her seven-year relationship almost a year ago-and now, less than a month away from saying goodbye to her 20s. 🥹 This episode comes with a little PSA: trust your gut, trust yourself, and remember that people see you. Sometimes you need to hear that. M also schools us on the moon (again, our girl came prepared with another fantastic book for reference 🌙📚), and Syd waits until the VERY END to hit y’all with a wild Spill It, Bestie that is guaranteed to make you chuckle. Grab a drink, settle in, and come get a little weird with us. 💕

episodes.title: Can't Even External Monologue
episodes.description: This week's Sips of the Week are McDonald's Refreshers served in our cutest glasses-because we're classy like that. 🥂 Syd is sipping on a Sprite Berry Blast while M is enjoying the Mango Pineapple, and our adorable hats somehow spiral into one of the messiest Spill It, Bestie conversations we've had yet. Both of us recently had job interviews that didn't pan out, but we're choosing to see them for what they are: progress. Information is information, and every experience gets us one step closer to where we're meant to be. We chat about the importance of having people in your corner who genuinely want to see you succeed and celebrate the little wins along the way. Syd and her hubby also caught The Odyssey (10/10, highly recommend!) and absolutely lost it over the preview for the upcoming To Catch a Predator movie. Naturally, this sends us down a rabbit hole about Syd's movie obsession, Christopher Nolan, and eventually... how completely exhausted we are by our own brains. 😂 We also celebrate some good karma as Syd and her hubby find a "new-to-them" car thanks to the kindness of some truly wonderful people. From there, we fully embrace the chaos and compare all of our brain quirks-from having what feels like 100 safari tabs open at all times (they're all important, okay?!) to realizing we both have a nonstop internal monologue. By the end of the episode, we've reached one very important conclusion: we live in Chitter Chatter Brain Brain , while some people are apparently out here living in a silent movie. We genuinely can't relate.

episodes.title: Trauma Glitching & Soap Box Crash Outs
episodes.description: Happy Episode 30!! This week's Sip of the Week is a summery blend called Tea Frog , served in the new spooky cups Syd brought back from her trip home. She also introduced M to the infamous Double Kiwi gas station pizza rolls , and if you've never had them... consider this your official sign to change that. Syd shares the exciting news that she'll be a matron of honor for her longest bestie, which immediately sends M down a history rabbit hole. We uncover why matrons of honor exist and somehow come to the completely logical conclusion that Syd should be carrying a sword down the aisle. We also spend some time appreciating the charm of small-town living, swap stories about Syd's incredibly wise 92-year-old great-grandpa, and reflect on the kind of community that seems harder and harder to find. To wrap things up, we're sharing real-time updates on the Nolan Wells case while trying to sort through the overwhelming amount of misinformation circulating online. Our biggest takeaway? Have some humanity. Behind every headline is a real family living through unimaginable grief. Thanks for letting us step onto our soapbox for a minute. Catch us next week for another crash out. 💚

episodes.title: The Questions Around Nolan Wells & Our Weekly Chaos
episodes.description: We didn't even care about our Sips of the Week because we had the real Treat of the Week! M made the most incredible homemade peach cobbler using fresh peaches from a roadside stand, and honestly...it completely stole the show. We paired it with a classic brown sugar latte as we both continue our yearly transition into fall the second the Fourth of July is over. The bulk of today's episode is spent discussing the heartbreaking and still-developing case of 18-year-old Nolan Wells. After spending the Fourth of July on an island in Mississippi with friends, Nolan was reported missing by his mom that same night after those friends left the island without him and without notifying anyone. His body was found on the island two days later, and as of recording, many questions remain unanswered while we await autopsy results and more information. Sydney walks through the timeline, the strange details surrounding the case, and the similarities that have us asking even more questions as we tumble down another true crime rabbit hole together. Before we wrap up, Sydney gives everyone a very last-minute invitation to her and her hubby's island party (weather permitting, of course), and somehow that turns into a conversation about how difficult it is to build yourself up, chase your dreams, and start your own business without much support. We finish things off with a few more Real Life Realizations as we reflect on how much we've grown. Grab your favorite coffee, dessert, or both, and come chittin' and chattin' with us. 🤎

episodes.title: Stars, Stripes, Milkshakes, and Tangents
episodes.description: This week's Sips of the Week were inspired by 7 Brew! We took our favorite drinks, added some ice cream, and turned them into delicious milkshake concoctions that were so worth it. In the spirit of the 4th of July , we dive into some American history... and, as always, end up taking a few unexpected detours along the way. We learn why hot dogs became the unofficial food of Independence Day, where the famous hot dog eating contest came from, and chat about some of Syd's favorite travels to some pretty cool places. We also get into the absolutely wild dreams Syd has been having all week, and-perhaps the biggest milestone of the episode-we officially had our first legitimate cat appearance on the podcast! Grab your favorite drink, get comfy, and come hang out with us for another chaotic, cozy episode of Chittin' and Chattin'!

episodes.title: Two Sauce Queens and Their Quirks
episodes.description: This week's Sips of the Week was a refreshing passionfruit margarita while we welcomed the first day of summer with a little chat about paganism and the changing of the seasons. 🍹☀️ We wasted absolutely no time jumping into Spill It, Bestie , and WOW... this one was a doozy. The final verdict? Don't give the "nice guy" a chance just because he's nice-it might not be worth it. 😂 That conversation naturally snowballed into another Spill It, Bestie where we vent about people (mostly men... and narcissists 👀) who listen just to prepare their rebuttal instead of actually hearing someone else's perspective. We also talk about the beauty of true friendships-the kind where your bestie can lovingly point out the things you aren't seeing, and you trust them enough to actually listen. 💛 On a lighter note, Syd got a replacement wedding band for work and has officially become a silicone ring collector, rotating between what feels like eight different wedding bands depending on the day. She also casually drops that she's now bench pressing 115 pounds , so... everyone stay on your best behavior. 💪 M's cats make their first-ever (very brief) appearance on the podcast, and we discuss how one of them is... let's just say, incredibly unique. 😅 Naturally, we also end up ranking all of our favorite sauces because, as it turns out, we're both absolute sauce queens. To wrap up Pride Month, Syd brings one last round of LGBTQ+ facts, including some fascinating history from ancient Egypt and Greece. We also announce an upcoming episode about religious trauma , so if you'd like to share your story or experience, we'd love for you to write in. ❤️

episodes.title: Dykes on Bikes and Donuts
episodes.description: This week's Sips of the Week was a cozy coffee paired with an assortment of donuts from King Donuts and some absolutely incredible chocolate hazelnut-filled beignets. We kick things off by talking about the wild storms that rolled through overnight and had both of us waking up wondering if we had somehow ended up in the middle of a disaster movie. Then we dive right into M's spontaneous trip to Nashville for a concert! Along the way, we both learn what a hat trick actually is (spoiler: not what either of us thought). The concert recap leads us into a conversation about why you should absolutely support smaller artists when you can. Syd shares stories about watching artists like HonestAv and Evan Honer grow from small venues to opening for some of their favorite musicians, and we spend a little time appreciating talented people who also happen to be genuinely good humans. Of course, Syd takes us down a rabbit hole explaining the connections between MGK, HonestAv, Mod Sun, and basically everyone else in the music universe-just let her cook. We also uncover some interesting personal details about Syd and spend a questionable amount of time trying to determine whether she's weird or just uniquely herself. In true Chittin' and Chattin' fashion, we bounce from concert stories to a Louisville true crime case recently covered by Crime Junkie, talk about our boat day and rope swing adventures, and celebrate a huge gym win after Syd successfully bench pressed 115 pounds! For our Gay Fact of the Week, we're talking about the legendary Dykes on Bikes and the Litas biker group. So grab your favorite drink, settle in, and join us for another chaotic, cozy conversation full of music, storms, boats, biker history, and way too many tangents.

episodes.title: You Gotta Talk Me Through This...
episodes.description: This week's sips of the week were a much-needed two-parter: some de-stress tea that honestly revived our souls, followed by a shot of vodka mixed with Sydney's very first Bloom drink. Listen, we're bartenders and life has been life-ing lately, so we're just keeping it real with y'all. In honor of Pride Month, Sydney brings another fun Pride history fact to the table and explains why we say LGBTQ instead of the old GLBT acronym. Shoutout to @AcceptingUncleMurphy on TikTok for sending us down that rabbit hole! That conversation naturally led us to our movie of the week, Dallas Buyers Club , which had both of us crying before we even sat down to record. If you haven't watched it yet, consider this your sign-but fair warning, there are definitely spoilers ahead as we dive into our favorite scenes and what made the film so impactful. Our Spill It, Bestie segment this week is a healing one, featuring Sydney witnessing a man being a true ally in the wild. M also bites her cheek mid-episode, which somehow results in us taking another shot. As one does. We get into healing, nature bathing, natural sounds and vibrations, lowering cortisol levels, and finding ways to calm our overstimulated brains. Along the way, we laugh about the differences between being raised in Colorado versus Eastern Kentucky, show off our fresh new hair, discuss why life is actually a lot longer than it feels, and try to figure out whether Sydney's wild dreams are just proof that her brain never, ever clocks out. Grab a tea, a Bloom, or whatever is getting you through the week, and come chittin' and chattin' with us.

episodes.title: Happy Pride! We Love You in all Your Phases
episodes.description: Happy Pride Month, friends! 🌈💖 This week we're celebrating love, community, and the beautiful history behind Pride Month. Our Sips of the Week were boozy Sunset Sarsaparilla floats inspired by the Fallout universe (thank you, Costco), and honestly, they were as fun as they sound. We kick things off with some Pride history, including why Pride Month is celebrated in June and some of the hard-fought milestones in queer rights. A huge shoutout to Louisville creator @itskaylajaiden for inspiring our first fact of the episode! M shares her excitement about attending her very first Pride festival this year, while Syd takes a trip down memory lane and talks about her first Pride experience as a little baby 18-year-old. Along the way, we talk about why it's so difficult to understand the hate surrounding Pride when, at its core, Pride is simply about love. We share a few stories, discuss the importance of representation, and Syd tries to convince M that she absolutely must watch BOOTS on Netflix (bring tissues). We also have a heartfelt conversation about the reality that there are still people who wake up every day believing they'd be better off not being here than living as their authentic selves. If that's you, we want you to know that we love you, we're glad you're here, and the world is better with you in it. The episode wraps up with a conversation about loving ourselves and each other through every phase of life-much like our beloved moon, which is beautiful in every phase it goes through. And before we go: we're thinking about covering an unsolved true crime case in a future episode! If there's one you're dying to hear us discuss, send us your suggestions. Happy Pride, and thank you for being here. 🌈✨

episodes.title: The Other Day = 10 Years Ago
episodes.description: Sips of the week was a cozy coffee paired with M’s homemade muffin tin brownies with walnuts - which of course sent Syd into a story about her great aunt lovingly known as “Bessie Cracking Walnuts.” Naturally. We get into Syd’s obsession with her favorite little shop out of Maine, Mexicali Blues, and why she absolutely cannot be trusted on their online store for the sake of financial restraint. M dives into the meaning behind her new tattoo sleeve and all the beautiful details that symbolize getting her sparkle back, while Syd opens up about how someone can seem like they have it all together while life underneath feels harddd. We laugh about only getting rage baited by the people we love most and spiral into societal expectations, being unapologetically yourself, and somehow Syd accidentally dropping genuinely good advice: “whatever you have to give to the world, give it - and the right people will find it and appreciate it.” We also talk about being bartenders/therapists, M’s moon knowledge and crystal charging expertise, and Syd’s freaky intuition being on ten yet again. This episode is cozy, chaotic, honest, and cut a little short because we’re working gals and had to run. Love ya!!!

episodes.title: Bruised Tailbones and Healing Trauma Brains
episodes.description: Sips of the week were peanut butter iced coffees paired perfectly with chips and queso while our brains rode the absolute struggle bus. We dive into M’s trip back home to Colorado, Syd bruising her tailbone because of course she did, and why M is officially a big strong girl now. Syd’s husband also survived Sonic Temple (barely) and made it home with stories… including his car getting broken into hahaha. We get into bartender personalities, someone complimenting Syd’s microexpressions, and M becoming fully obsessed with her new earrings. From there, the episode takes a softer turn into our mini healing inbox where we talk about giving yourself grace, recognizing how far you’ve come, and learning to live with a healing trauma brain. M brings up the tarot card “4 of Wands,” we discuss the moon doing moon things, and Syd explains why she thought she was about to get sex trafficked at Waffle House. We also talk friendship bracelets for our little friend group, questioning your sexuality with an open mind, and how dangerous certain words can be-especially to a child. We end the episode talking about the beauty of having friendships where you can say your darkest or weirdest thoughts out loud and still feel loved, heard, and seen. As always, our healing inbox is open. Feel free to reach out to us on socials or by email. ♡

episodes.title: I'm Sorry I Bursted Your Bubble
episodes.description: This episode is powered by a GIANT spicy mango margarita literally the size of our heads paired perfectly with killer chips & queso - as all good decisions are. We filmed ahead of time because M is back home in Colorado spending Mother’s Day with her momma, which naturally led us into talking about how women’s bodies are still wildly under-researched (shocking, we know). We dive into women’s intuition, our weirdly telepathic friend group connection, and a TikTok Sydney saw that said “I’m not a thermometer, I’m the thermostat” - and honestly? life changing. We’re also celebrating M getting back to her spontaneous self, which naturally turns into us reminiscing on our chaotic college days and some… questionable stories hahaha. From there we spiral into festival culture, music festivals, possibly taking the podcast on the road, and Sydney being a master trip planner(seriously, hit her up). We also chuckle over our shared love for Cars and how Sydney used to watch Mater's Tall Tales on repeat with her little brother. We get into how much we genuinely love the freedom and lifestyle that comes with bartending and how neither of us really knows if we ever want a traditional 9-5 life. Somewhere in the middle of all this, we also discuss figuring out how to monetize the podcast without being annoying about it… so peace and love hehe.

episodes.title: The World is Better With You in It
episodes.description: 20 episodes?! That’s 20 whole weeks of hanging out with us and listening to our chaotic little conversations, and we seriously couldn’t be more grateful. This week’s Sips of the Week were brown sugar caramel iced coffees served in the cutest Dolly Parton cups gifted by Syd’s mother-in-law… which immediately sent us into our feelings after seeing Dolly’s recent video and absolutely crushed our souls. This episode gets a little reflective as Syd talks about how she and her hubby grew into their marriage instead of letting marriage put them into a box, while M opens up about rediscovering herself and getting back to who she was before her last relationship. We also dive into the difference between a disagreement and a full-blown argument and why healthy relationships don’t have to feel like a battlefield. Of course, we balance the emotional growth with absolute nonsense because our Spill It, Bestie story about grown men acting like manchildren had us cracking up. Plus, Syd’s sugar butt and his bestie are off on a boys trip to Sonic Temple, so naturally we had thoughts. We wrap everything up by talking about how important it is to surround yourself with people who genuinely want the best for you - because there’s enough room for all of us to win. 🤎

episodes.title: Here's Your Warning... TMI
episodes.description: This week’s Sips of the Week is a chaotic (but delicious) mix-Japanese mango cream soda + vodka… basically a mango screwdriver and we’re not mad about it. We’re both a little all over the place this episode (life is a scam, everything is a scam, you get it), but in between the chaos, M opens up about her recent crash-outs and how Syd has helped her realize that spiraling doesn’t have to ruin your whole day. Growth… kinda. Syd shares a story about her intuition being on 100 and showing up as a safe space when someone needed it most, and we get into the heaviness of living with CPTSD and how everyday life can feel a little extra overwhelming. We also dive into Syd’s very official (and slightly unhinged) “theories” on relationships. M got a new tattoo (!!) and is gearing up for her sleeve, plus we get into a real and funny convo about sexuality and figuring yourself out-even at 29. Of course, it wouldn’t be an episode without our usual wacky dream recaps, a heartfelt moment about a teacher who truly got it, and a message from a listener who set boundaries after listening to the pod (cue us sobbing). Oh-and Syd educates M on a classic Vine she somehow missed. PSA: If someone can’t respect your boundaries, they don’t respect you. Period.

episodes.title: Cruise Recap and Recovery
episodes.description: Sips of the Week is M’s elite concoction-mango and spicy chili tea paired with pastries from her homemade breakfast (chef energy, always). Meanwhile, we are both just… surviving. Syd threw her back out (again) and M’s eye is swollen shut from allergies, so truly everything is going great over here. On the bright side, Syd did manage to shave her legs with a broken back, so resilience is alive and well. We recap Syd’s cruise-new friends, fun adventures, and all the chaos you’d expect-while M has been in full nesting mode, turning her apartment into the cutest, coziest space. We spiral a bit about how the ocean is both breathtaking and absolutely terrifying (and yes, we stand by the fact that mermaids are real). Syd also gives M a list of movies she needs to watch, and of course, she was already planning her next trip before even making it home-Puerto Rico is definitely calling her back. While Syd was gone, M surprised her with a snack basket from around the world that is truly next-level. We also get into Syd’s go-to travel hack-booking big vacations through Costco and all the unexpected perks that come with it. Grab a drink, get comfy, and come hang out with us-this one’s a mix of travel stories, chaos, and just trying to hold it together.

episodes.title: Let the Lizards Get Him
episodes.description: This week we are feeling accomplished because why are we filming at 11am like productive queens?? ☀️ Fueled by M’s incredible home-cooked breakfast (chef’s kiss 👩‍🍳), we kick things off with Syd unlocking a childhood memory of leftover biscuits with Karo syrup… and honestly, we’re not mad about it 😌 Sips of the Week ☕✨ is a cozy coffee moment-M whipped up a spiced creation and Syd made it extra sweet with French vanilla creamer + cinnamon sugar (because balance). We’re getting ahead of the game this week since Syd will be living her best life on a CRUISE when this drops 🚢💅 because we stay booked & busy-especially with summer jobs around the corner! We cover a little bit of everything: 💄 Syd’s face is finally recovering thanks to her ride-or-die Dollar Tree products (don’t sleep on them!!) 🌀 Adults learning cause & effect… aka karma is THAT girl 💅 Nothing bothers Syd… until it comes to messing with her man 👀 💍 Big moves!! Syd & her hubby’s new business already has 3 weddings potentially booked (!!) and M might be entering her freelance bartending era 🍸 💸 Tax Day check-in-M filed her taxes solo and lived to tell the tale Syd also breaks down her cruise must-haves (and what people always forget 👀), plus shares a hilarious middle-of-the-night dream panic moment with her husband that had us crying laughing 😭 We get a little deeper talking about: 🍼 Why more people are waiting to have kids-and why it’s never okay to ask someone when they’re having them 🗣️ Letting go of outdated mindsets around kids and family Spill it, Bestie 💔 gets heavy this week as we discuss a heartbreaking story out of Syd’s hometown and how small-town dynamics can sometimes let serious issues go unchecked. But don’t worry-we send you off with a laugh because M is about to be left completely unsupervised while Syd is on vacation… and we’re a little concerned 😂

episodes.title: Heal Your Weird Out
episodes.description: This week’s episode is giving cozy, reflective, and just the right amount of unhinged 🤭 Sips of the Week is a surprise find from Jungle Jim’s - an amazing Riesling in the CUTEST black cat bottle 🐈‍⬛🍷 paired perfectly with a quirky little Turkish delight treat that Syd picked out (she really nailed the vibe on this one). We get into some unexpected backstory this episode - learning about M’s family ties to the original Homestead Act and realizing that even though we grew up 19 hours apart, our childhoods were weirdly similar 🫶 cue all the nostalgic talk about grandparents making homemade jams and our sudden desire to become that kind of people. Things get a little deeper as we talk about healing - like the kind where you finally feel safe enough to fully be your weird, authentic self around your people 💅 and honestly? we’re living for it. We also touch on M’s casual CPTSD and swap some birthday trauma stories (you know… as one does 😅), which somehow turns into hyping up Syd’s husband (as we SHOULD) and sharing some exciting life updates 👀 Big news: Syd and her hubby are starting their own DJ business 🎧✨ and it inspires M to start her freelance bartending era… we love a main character moment!! And of course, we wrap things up with some wholesome updates on M’s cats because balance is everything 🐾 Grab your drink and come chittin’ and chattin’ with us - this one feels like a warm hug with a little chaos mixed in 🤍

episodes.title: We'll Circle Back Eventually...
episodes.description: Welcome back to Chittin' and Chattin' - where we dive into whatever is happening in our brains... This week's Sips of the Week is a refreshing mango tea sangria infused with rosé, and let’s just say… she paired PERFECTLY with the international snack haul from Syd’s trip to Jungle Jim’s in Cincinnati 🍹🌍 M really did her thing with this one. Our brains were all over the place today - up, down, and sideways - but that didn’t stop us from bringing the chaos. M shares an absolutely tragic pick-up line that somehow still had us cracking up, and this week’s Spill It, Bestie is a WILD one… like calling-in-on-your-second-day-of-training wild 😅 We also get into the absolute madness of Saturday night bartending (including a full-on brawl 👀), and Syd tells the story of a time she stood UP for herself right before her bachelorette trip - growth, baby 💅 Oh, and in today’s “you can’t make this up” moment: Syd’s dad (fresh outta jail… again) is now posting original songs on TikTok 💀 To top it all off, we filmed TWO episodes in one day for the first time ever because Syd’s about to be on vacayyyy ✈️🌴 Grab your drink, besties - this one is a ride.

episodes.title: Oh No, Maybe I AM a Cat Person...
episodes.description: Hey besties 💙✨ This week’s Sips of the Week might actually be the BEST we’ve ever made 👀 - a mango tea with Nick’s Sick Mix + honey 🥭🍯 and it is the most soothing, perfect spring blend. We’re out here fighting for our lives with this weather though 🤧 because why are our sinuses acting like we’re “dying away”?? spring, explain yourself. M shows off her phenomenal new tattoo and we get into a convo about being strong, powerful, AND feminine all at the same time - cue Sydney’s love for Ilona Maher because she embodies that energy perfectly 💪✨ Life is picking up, we’re busy bee’s 🐝 and gearing up for our summer job on the water 🌊☀️ AND our surprise from last week is finally revealed… M got TWO kittens 🥹🐱 they’re siblings, just over a year old, and we are OBSESSED. Meet Aine (Irish for happiness + light) and Caius (Latin for bringer of joy… but also sounds like chaos, which tracks 😂). Cats are healing and have an 8th sense, so they know just what we need. This also just confirmed that Sydney's dog (Plop) is actually a cat. We also get into normalizing bodily functions (because why is that still taboo??) and how differently we were raised - Sydney grew up very open about everything, while M… not so much lol. Also, Sydney is officially a strong girly 💅 she benched 115 lbs (yes that’s a 35 on each side!!) and we are PROUD 👏 To wrap it up, Spill It, Bestie gets into some absolutely wild news headlines because what is going on fr 😭 Grab your drink, get comfy, and come chittin’ and chattin’ with us 💬✨

episodes.title: And THEN his card declined
episodes.description: Hi Friends! Get ready to talk about whatever's going on in our brains! This week’s Sips of the Week is a springy dream - coffee with homemade blueberry creamer 🫐☕ and we are FEELING the fresh vibes. Happy Ostara!! Sydney blesses us with her very own rendition of “Allstar”… but make it for her dog 🐶🎤 (you’re welcome in advance). We get into a little real talk about adults who simply cannot read the room - and a PSA: just because we’re your bartender does NOT mean it’s okay to stalk us, and it definitely doesn’t make us friends 👀🚩 We chat about being recovering people pleasers while also living by our Crime Junkie rules… because sometimes being “rude” is actually just staying alive. And let’s be honest - our version of rude is still pretty nice 😂 There’s some unexpected tea from a random lady while Sydney was waiting for her Friday the 13th tattoos ☕👀 and M is gearing up for a BIG tattoo tomorrow - we are equal parts excited and nervous!! We also touch on Sydney’s upcoming cruise 🌊☀️ and hint at a little surprise coming your way soon… stay tuned 👀✨ Thanks for healing out loud with us💬

episodes.title: That's Not A Rabbit Hole I've Been Down
episodes.description: Hi friends! Welcome back to Chittin’ and Chattin’ - where we dive into whatever’s happening in our brains. 🎙️✨ This week’s Sips of the Week is a cozy cup of green tea jasmine while we recap Sydney’s whirlwind trip to Cleveland. From sharing her must-see spots , to making the mandatory stop at the 27 Club Coffee (yes, the one owned by Machine Gun Kelly ☕), Syd walks us through the highlights. She also hit a Cleveland Cavaliers game, went to a concert, and ate some seriously amazing food along the way. And if that wasn’t enough traveling… she was barely home for a full day before she and her hubby packed back up and drove to Cincinnati for another concert because their life motto is basically: “We can sleep when we’re dead.” 😂 We also chat about the idea that putting positive energy into the universe can bring positive things back to you , and how shifting your mindset can really change the way life feels. ✨ Of course, we try to tackle a Spill it, Bestie submission… but quickly spiral into wondering if we’re being pranked instead. 👀 And in the Healing Inbox , we get a little deeper as we talk about Complex Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (CPTSD) and Relationship Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (RPTSD) , opening up about healing and understanding how past experiences can affect us today. So grab a sip, settle in, and come chit and chat with us. ☕💬

episodes.title: Get To Know Your Hosts!
episodes.description: Hi friends! Welcome back to Chittin’ and Chattin’ - where we dive into whatever’s happening in our brains. 🎙️✨ This week’s Sips of the Week was a spicy tea that we very scientifically paired with Girl Scout cookies and banana peppers … because why not? 😂 Syd also manages to literally spill her tea at one point, which honestly feels very on-brand for us. We chat about the importance of appreciating different cultures, learning a few basic phrases when traveling, and showing respect for the places and people we visit. 🌎 We’re also starting a new little segment called “Get to Know Your Hosts” where we go full interview-style on each other. M asks Sydney how she met her hubby (since we talk about him all the time), and Syd shares their Tinder meet-cute that somehow turned into the perfect love story . 💕 Sydney flips the script and asks M about the moment she realized she needed to leave her seven-year relationship and how she navigated such a difficult decision. We talk about how strong and smart she was for leaving when she did-and, as fellow crime junkies, we also acknowledge how scary that situation could have been. At the end of the day, we reflect on how sometimes life unfolds exactly the way it’s meant to, even when it doesn’t feel like it at the time. Grab a sip, get comfy, and come chit and chat with us. ☕💬

episodes.title: Questionably Transparent
episodes.description: Hi friends!!! 🎉 Welcome back to Chittin’ and Chattin’ and can you believe it?! This is our 10th episode 🥹✨ This week’s Sips of the Week was the most perfectly moody tea called “The Raven” - dramatic, mysterious, and honestly fitting for the unhinged tangents we went on. ☕🖤 We’re counting down to Sydney’s upcoming cruise (someone cue the sunscreen and delusion) and fully romanticizing spring like it’s a personality trait. 🌷⚓ We absolutely threw TMI out the window this episode and said let’s normalize the things EVERYONE goes through but no one wants to say out loud. You’re welcome. 🫣😂 We also got into a real talk moment about how “protecting your peace” can sometimes just be putting yourself in an emotional hostage situation - and whew… that one hit. And of course, we had to unpack Sydney’s cinematic, plot-twist-filled dreams - including the fact that her sweet husband literally apologized to her for something he did… in her dream. The green flag energy is unmatched. 💀👏 It’s cozy. It’s chaotic. It’s honest. It’s episode TEN, baby. As always - send in your Spill it, Bestie and Healing Inbox submissions. We’re chittin’, we’re chattin’, and we’re apparently dream-processing too. 💌✨

episodes.title: Who Gave Me Tequila?? With Our First Ever Special Guest!!
episodes.description: Hi friends! Welcome back to Chittin’ and Chattin’ - where we dive into whatever is happening in our brains… and this week we brought backup 👀🍓 We had our first ever guest - our girl Lauren!!! And since we’re all three bartenders, it was only right that our Sips of the Week were fresh strawberry margaritas handcrafted by Laur herself. Let’s just say… it quickly turned into a little midday margarita madness and the giggles were flowing. We get into the lore: how we all have college degrees, how life said “plot twist,” and how we somehow ended up behind the bar because… bills must be paid, bestie. We talk small-town upbringings (same but wildly different), Lauren’s soccer days playing through college, and the universal experience of trying to figure it out in your 20s. Somewhere between tequila sips, we discover the concept of “burger music” and apparently Sydney gives off that exact vibe??? (Still processing.) We also start planning a group trip - will it make it out of the group chat? TBD. And of course, we could not go one episode without acknowledging Sydney’s amazing husband - our fearless protector, our security system, our king. This episode is chaotic, wholesome, slightly unhinged, and full of bartender wisdom you didn’t ask for but absolutely needed. 🍓🍹

episodes.title: So We Move To L.A...
episodes.description: Hi friends! Welcome back to Chittin’ and Chattin’ - where we romanticize our lives, spill a little tea, and heal out loud ☕✨ This week’s Sips of the Week felt extra magical as we made coffee inspired by a book we picked up in Salem called Coffee for the Modern Witch (because obviously we’re leaning into our cozy, mystical era). Syd was sipping from the Valentine’s mug her sweet hubby gifted her - complete with a chaotic internet meme quote that truly represents her spirit. We chat all about our Valentine’s Day plans, what love looks like in this season of life, and then… whew. The tea was HOT for Spill it, Bestie 🫖 We had plenty to say and did not hold back. Also - can we talk about the Super Bowl halftime show?! We were absolutely swooning. The talent. The energy. The obsession. Consider us unwell. On a deeper note, we spent time healing out loud and unpacking something we both struggle with: asking for help. Why is it so hard? Why do we convince ourselves we have to do everything alone? Vulnerability was in the building, but so was growth 💌 Cozy. A little witchy. A little delulu. A lot of honesty. Grab your favorite mug and come chittin’ and chattin’ with us 🤍

episodes.title: This is Just Me As a Human
episodes.description: Hi friends! We’re fully leaning into the vibes, wearing our matching “ Overstimulated ” shirts (a sweet gift from a friend) while everything around us looks like a literal winter wonderland ❄️🤍 Sydney is deep in her newest obsession with the show Heated Rivalry and is doing her absolute best to convince M to watch it (jury’s still out 👀). Meanwhile, M dives into her long-standing love for Cats - yes, that Cats - because once you’re in, you’re IN 🐱🎭 We get into some laughs about toxic masculinity, have a real moment about not comparing your life to others, and remind ourselves (and you) that everyone’s timeline looks different - and that’s okay 🫶 Grab a cozy drink and come chittin’ and chattin’ with us 💬✨ As always, thanks for healing out loud with us.
